questions.question: Quiz 1: What triggers a provider failover in the Allternit platform?
options: A user explicitly clicks "Switch Provider" in settings
A gateway candidate returns a retryable status or throws a network error
The circuit breaker transitions from Closed to Open state
The Redis cache TTL expires for a provider response
questions.explanation: A gateway candidate returns a retryable status or throws a network error

questions.question: Quiz 2: Why cache responses from external APIs?
options: To avoid paying for API requests during development
Because external APIs are always slower than local databases
To reduce latency, cost, and provider load for repeated or similar requests
To store user credentials securely across sessions
questions.explanation: To reduce latency, cost, and provider load for repeated or similar requests

questions.question: Quiz 3: How does the platform protect API keys from leaking in logs?
options: By hashing all API keys with SHA-256 before every request
Server-only env vars + Zod validation + encrypted storage at rest
By rotating API keys every 60 seconds using a cron job
By Base64-encoding keys in the query string instead of headers
questions.explanation: Server-only env vars + Zod validation + encrypted storage at rest
